items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

ctx.x: Richard Powell was my pianist. You see, Bud Powell’s brother. He was my pianist, you know? And I’m saying Kenny Burrell, all of them at one time or the other played that music, because that’s the basis of everything that they do. You know and if jazz indeed had its beginning in New Orleans, please, what was that, you know? The funerals? You’ve got to see that, have you ever seen one in New Orleans? You know what that’s like. If you can stay still, I’ll bet you, you can’t. But that’s like the old people used to…
